evidence_fusion_invariant: Foundation uses frozen repetition-free greedy decoding. ASCENT retains the complete Foundation prediction and appends only completed seven-digit runs decoded in query order from the latent state by the independently trained linear head. It cannot remove a correct Foundation value; incomplete runs are discarded.
redesign_rationale: The 60/78-token power-law development comparison still lost 0.03125 gain because two low-scale evidence values remained too strong. The concave global law targets approximately one, three, and four complete facts while remaining independent of any test target or Foundation prediction.
